a: A Pod is the smallest deployable unit — one or more containers sharing network/storage.
A Deployment manages replica Pods and rolling updates.
A Service provides a stable virtual IP/DNS to reach Pods.
Ingress routes external HTTP(S) traffic to Services with rules/hosts.
ConfigMaps inject non-secret configuration into Pods.
Secrets store sensitive data (base64-encoded by default; encrypt at rest in prod).
Namespaces isolate resources within a cluster for teams/environments.
Liveness probes restart containers that are stuck.
Readiness probes control when a Pod receives traffic.
Horizontal Pod Autoscaler scales replicas based on CPU/metrics.
